Like most operators, Bridgeway had treated the end-of-shift note as the cost of doing business. Until they found voize. Their success story shows how using voize enabled them to make their progress notes a true clinical asset.

### How Caritas Stuttgart increased their documentation quality

As one of the first facilities of Caritas Stuttgart, Haus St. Barbara helped shape voize from the very beginning. With voize, the facility has significantly reduced overtime and documentation workload, achieving a quality level that in 2025 led, for the first time, to the facility not needing to be re-inspected by the Medical Review Board (German equivalent to the CMS) for an entire year.
